identification: Cream painted composition/cork fire helmet (Merryweather/London pattern shape) with red enamel FBC badge, Fire Brigades Commission of Tasmania (1945-1979 era). Green lined underside, leather liner and chinstrap. Paint loss to comb and rim. Likely mid-20th century.

entries.note: Vintage fireman's helmet, brown canvas and compressed cork, London pattern c1938-41. Same construction type but not Tasmanian, no badge. Database record only, page not opened. Hammer, no premium.

Hobart Fire Brigade antique leather and brass officer's helmet c1900. Older, brass, officer grade and named Hobart, so well above this painted composition helmet. Upper bound only. Database record only.
NSW Fire Brigade 19th century brass helmet. Different material and age, category guide only. Database record only.
Melbourne MFB brass helmet c1950, fair. Old sale (over 10 years), brass. Database record only.
Fire Brigades Commission of Tasmania long service medal. Shows collector demand for FBC Tasmania items only, not a helmet. Database record only.

viewing_check: Look inside for maker or size stamp, date, owner name or brigade number; check the FBC badge is original and firmly attached; check the cork/composition shell for cracks or dents and whether the liner is complete.
